target.title: refactor(anthropic): unify GA 1M model detection with shared capability helper
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Three code paths independently maintain their own lists of "which Anthropic models support 1M context", using different mechanisms:

| File | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| `src/agents/context-resolution.ts` | Hardcoded `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` list |
| `extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.ts` | Second hardcoded `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` list |
| `extensions/anthropic/register.runtime.ts` | `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()` capability helper |

Adding a new 1M model requires updating both hardcoded lists in lockstep. When they drift (as with #100572 for Fable 5), one path recognizes the model as 1M while the other does not — causing silent feature degradation (e.g. missing beta headers, wrong context window).

The immediate trigger was `claude-cli + claude-fable-5` falling back to 200K because the Fable 5 guard in `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` excluded `claude-cli`. But the underlying issue is the duplicated lists, not the missing provider.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace both hardcoded `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` lists with `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()`, the shared capability helper from `packages/llm-core/src/model-contracts/anthropic.ts`. This helper is already the canonical source used by `register.runtime.ts`, multiple provider plugins (Bedrock, Vertex, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry), and the Claude thinking pipeline.

Concrete changes:
- `src/agents/context-resolution.ts`: delete the prefix list; use `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking()` for the GA 1M fallback branch. Fable 5 / Mythos 5 guards drop their per-provider restriction since the outer `isAnthropicProvider` check already covers all three providers.
- `extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.ts`: delete the second prefix list; `isAnthropic1MModel()` delegates entirely to the shared helper.

This is a net-negative-LOC refactor (2 files, +16/−39) that makes the 1M model list single-source. Adding a future model like `claude-sonnet-4-7` will only need the regex update in `packages/llm-core`.

## User Impact

All existing behavior is preserved. `claude-cli + claude-fable-5` now correctly resolves to 1M (was the original trigger). All three Anthropic-affiliated providers (anthropic, anthropic-vertex, claude-cli) benefit from the unified detection for all current and future GA 1M models.

## Evidence

### Unit tests (228 passed, 0 failed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/context.test.ts \
    extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts \
    src/agents/embedded-agent-runner-extraparams.test.ts

[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9 /home/0668000452/codes/OPENSOURCES/openclaw
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  205 passed (205)
   Start at  23:30:37
   Duration  14.87s

[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-providers.config.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9 /home/0668000452/codes/OPENSOURCES/openclaw
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  23 passed (23)
   Start at  23:30:57
   Duration  5.81s

[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 36.28s
```

### Key test coverage for the fix

**`resolveContextTokensForModel` (context-resolution):**
- ✓ returns the fixed context for unconfigured claude-cli model claude-fable-5
- ✓ returns the fixed context for unconfigured claude-cli model claude-sonnet-5
- ✓ honors an authored claude-cli window for fixed model claude-fable-5
- ✓ ignores a materialized lower context window for fixed claude-cli model claude-fable-5
- ✓ ignores a materialized lower context window for fixed claude-cli model claude-sonnet-5

**`applyDiscoveredContextWindows` (discovery cache upgrade):**
- ✓ upgrades claude-cli GA 1M variants when discovery still reports 200k

**Stream wrappers (beta header injection):**
- ✓ uses Fable 5 identity boundaries for context1m beta wrapper activation
- ✓ strips legacy context-1m betas for Claude CLI or legacy token auth
- 23 tests passed total (beta headers, service tier, context1m wrapper activation)

### Commit history

```
ba64fc14ed refactor(anthropic): unify GA 1M model detection with shared capability helper
4a1919d4c0 fix(agents): resolve fable-5 1M context window for claude-cli provider
```

Behavior addressed: fragmented GA 1M model detection across context-resolution, stream-wrappers, and register.runtime
Real environment tested: Linux Node 24, local vitest
Exact commands run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/context.test.ts extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner-extraparams.test.ts`
Evidence after fix: 228 tests passed across 3 test files
Observed result after fix: All tests pass; `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking` is the single source of truth for GA 1M model detection; two duplicated prefix lists eliminated
What was not tested: Live gateway with actual claude-cli provider (requires Claude CLI subscription)
